name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 9 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
